designCorrections: P7 uses pg_catalog metadata because information_schema.columns is privilege-filtered and would require the metadata owner to receive forbidden business-table privileges
receipt_order_ids now accepts owner identity and joins orders because a bigint[]-only SECURITY DEFINER signature could not enforce ownership
P5B rehearsal replaced ambiguous PL/pgSQL column references with qualified columns or named constraints and declared the VIP UPSERT's implicit user_id/total_rub read
authorizationRefactors: Relay now calls five owner-or-session-token correlated methods; the order_id-only repository methods remain outside the Relay graph for later bot assessment
the redundant token_matches_order Relay call was removed because authorization is now atomic with each protected read
Montera and RSPay callbacks no longer fetch broad order/provider data by order_id solely for notification text
legacy numeric payment links use a two-hour order/user-bound bearer proof and never place RELAY_SECRET in the URL
supersededRehearsalOnlyFunction: relay_payment_session_token_matches_order remains in proposal 031 historical rehearsal evidence but is excluded from the current 43-read Relay target and any future rollout
rollback: The no-volume disposable container was stopped and removed; no production role, function, grant or row changed.
providerCallbackHardening: Vertu exact matches are provider-scoped; legacy suffix compatibility returns a row only when the suffix is unique, preventing nondeterministic cross-payout correlation.
